Dear Mr. Farrell,

Re: Account reference: ACC-518084

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the account referenced above. You have disputed the identity of the debt collector and the validity of the debt. We understand that you have requested validation of the debt.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA), 15 U.S.C. § 1692g, we are required to provide you with a written validation of the debt within 30 days of your request. We will investigate your dispute and provide you with the necessary documentation to support the debt.

We have reviewed the account information and confirmed that the original creditor is Clearview Medical Center and the current balance is $4,508.77. The account was charged off on August 13, 2022, and your last payment was received on July 9, 2024.

We will investigate the allegations of unwanted contact with your relatives and take necessary steps to ensure compliance with the FDCPA. You have the right to dispute the debt further, and we will provide you with a written validation of the debt as required by law.

Please note that we will not make any further attempts to contact you through any means other than the address and phone number you have provided to us.

Sincerely,

Continental Receivables Corp.
